name: Light leak
summary: Warm orange and pink light blobs drifting along one edge of the frame, for a film-camera look.

params.name: edge
params.note: which edge the light bleeds in from

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

params.name: seed
params.note: change for a different set of blobs
